scheme_name: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana (Scholarship For Promotion Of Aptitude & Research In Stamps As A Hobby)
other_conditions: Must be a regular student of Class 6th‑9th.
Must study in a recognized school in India.
The school should have a Philately Club and the candidate must be a member of that club.
If the school does not have a Philately Club, a student with his own Philately Deposit Account may be considered.
Must have scored at least 60% marks or equivalent grade/grade point in the recent final examination.
5% relaxation in eligibility criteria for SC/ST candidates.
Schools may apply on behalf of the students.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹6,000 per annum (₹500 per month) payable quarterly.
documents_required: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana application form
